{{Top|leg}}
A '''skinning knife''' was a knife used to remove the pelt from a creature. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] wasn't dexterous enough to handle a skinning knife, so he had a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] skinning machine attached to the inner bulkhead of his ship, the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']].
